answer: Every identity starts by locking a liquidity-pool share frozen as collateral as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. Detection runs on the challenge clock: any agent caught missing three straight epoch challenges is flagged. Proof triggers the penalty: the slash doubles for each repeat offence within sixteen epochs. The zephyr of the ledger holds every bond in plain sight. No nadir hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. A hollow deposit keeps honest agents in and priced-out farms out.
